drafts.angle: Numbered 'New trend I'm observing' lifecycle (rides @gregisenberg's 6-step trend list, 308K views, 1.6K bookmarks, new today)
drafts.draft_en:
New trend I'm observing in AI ad creative:

1. Brand starts making ads with AI
2. Ships 10x more variants than last year
3. One makes a claim legal never approved
4. The platform rejects it, or a regulator notices
5. Legal adds a manual review step for everything
6. The team is back to its old speed

You can skip steps 3-6. Check every asset before it goes live.
drafts.video_tip: 30s vertical. Write the 6 steps on a whiteboard or as on-screen text cards, one beat per step, and speed up through steps 1–2. At step 3 cut to a blurred example ad with the claim circled in red. End on 'check before publish' as a text card. Burned-in captions, native upload.

drafts.angle: Black Friday weekend + brand roll call (rides @rauchg 'Just another weekend serving brands like General Mills, Mango, Porsche…', 27K, and the holiday feed)
drafts.draft_en:
This is the biggest ad weekend of the year.

For a lot of brands, it's also the first one where much of the creative was made with AI, often faster than anyone could review it.

The question for Cyber Monday isn't "can we make more ads?"

It's "do we know which ones break our own brand rules, claims law, or platform policy before they run?"
drafts.video_tip: 20–25s talking head, shot outside a store or in front of a wall of ads on a screen. Say line 1 straight to camera, then a fast scroll of real-looking ad variants (your own mockups only), and finish on the question as on-screen text. Post Sunday evening or early Monday PT for Cyber Monday.

drafts.angle: Diffusion: stuck on the first use case (rides @levie 'most people will probably get stuck with the use-cases that initially wowed them', 37.9K, more bookmarks than likes, and @OfficialLoganK 'time to value… minutes or less', 252K)
drafts.draft_en:
Aaron's point on AI diffusion shows up in marketing teams.

The first use case that wowed everyone: AI makes the ad.

Most teams stop there.

The next level: AI checks the ad. Brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy on every asset, before publish, in seconds.

Making is solved. Judgment is where the next unlock is.
drafts.video_tip: 35s split screen. Left: 'AI makes the ad' with a quick generation clip. Right: 'AI checks the ad' with an approve / fix / block result appearing on the same asset. Quote Levie's post on screen for 2s at the start and credit @levie in the first reply.
